A quick method during the test
  1. Underline the data structure, required function names, and constraints (linked nodes, arrays, templates, inheritance).
  2. Choose a topic above. Search an operation such as “remove”, “reverse”, or “override”. Use the decision matrix if unsure.
  3. Expand a matching example. Check “What to change”, then copy the full program or a blank starter.
  4. Rename fields and methods to match the question. Keep one main(). Test empty, one-item, and several-item cases; check base/derived calls for inheritance.
Start here · Which example fits my question?

1. Identify what you must build. 2. Check required names, allowed containers and ownership. 3. Open the closest pattern and adapt the fields and operations.

“Implement a linked stack” means write nodes and links. “Use a stack” means use push/pop. Choose LIFO for last-in-first-out and FIFO for first-in-first-out. These are practice scenarios, not predictions of the exam.

If the question says…Start fromWhat to adaptTest first

Square is a special RectangleSquare derived from Rectangle →Pass side twice; reuse Rectangle::draw and override printMe.Equal dimensions; inherited moveTo works.
Add a new shape with extra dataTriangle implementation →Add fields and override draw/printMe.New calculation and polymorphic output.
“same interface”, “different algorithm”, persistent stateController + PID →Use controlStep; store memory between calls in members.Run two consecutive calls to verify state changes.
“reuse parent”, “limit”, “extend behavior”Override + base call →Call Base::method, then change the result.Results below, inside and above limits.
“define outside class”Class declarations + definitions →Use ReturnType ClassName::method(...).Signatures and const match the declarations.
“implement linked list”, “head”, “tail”, “next”Singly linked list skeleton →Build nodes and reconnect links; keep tail correct.Empty list, one node, many nodes, reuse after clearing.
“insert after”, “find a matching node”Insert after a target →Allocate using the old next, then reconnect.Head, middle, tail and missing target.
“insert in order”, “sorted list”Sorted insertion →Locate the predecessor; special-case the head.Smallest, largest and duplicate value.
“remove all”, “delete matching nodes”Delete all matches →Fix links before delete; do not skip adjacent matches.All matching, no matches, adjacent and tail matches.
“count”, “sum”, “average”, “traverse”Read-only traversal →Use a temporary pointer so head stays unchanged.Empty input and fractional average.
“implement push/pop/top”, “LIFO”, “linked stack”Lab 6 Stack<T> skeleton →Use topOfStack, StackNode, theItem and count.Last item out first; top does not remove; underflow.
“copy/preserve order”, “do not change source”Temporary-stack restoration →Reverse into temporary, then restore while copying.Source and destination pop in the same order.
“minimum”, “inspect all”, keep stack unchangedScan and restore →Accumulate while popping; restore from a temporary stack.Minimum below the top; original order survives.
“postfix”, operands followed by operatorsPostfix evaluator →Pop right operand before left operand.Subtraction order and missing operands.
“balanced parentheses”, nested delimitersDelimiter stack →Push opening delimiters; match each closer.Empty text, extra closer, unmatched opener.
“implement enqueue/dequeue”, “FIFO”, linked nodesLinkedQueue<T> skeleton →Insert at tail, remove at head; clear tail on final removal.FIFO order; empty → one → empty → enqueue again.
“fixed array”, “wraparound”, circular queueCourse ArrayQueue<T, size> →Use the given first/last sentinel and full/empty rules.Fill, remove, wrap, refill, underflow/overflow.
“filter”, “remove values”, preserve FIFO orderFilter with a fixed pass count →Process only the original queue size.All removed, none removed, survivors remain ordered.
“merge two sorted queues”Merge by comparing fronts →Take the smaller front; drain the remaining queue.One empty input and equal values.
“queue using two stacks”Two-stack FIFO adapter →Transfer only when outgoing is empty.Enqueue after some dequeues; no reordering.
“reverse queue using a stack”Queue → stack → queue →Use the supplied public operations.Zero, one and several items.
“return several named results”, “return a new array”Lab 3 return patterns →Struct for named fields; new[] for persistent arrays.Separate allocations; caller deletes each result.
“number unknown until runtime”, “maximum spacing”Lab 1 dynamic arrays →Compute count before allocating; ceil for maximum gap.Endpoints included; gap does not exceed the limit.
“validate”, “stop on non-number”, “weighted average”Lab 2 input loop →Retry out-of-range numbers; return false for failed extraction.Out-of-range input, q, incomplete pair, weight total.
“argv”, “append”, “peek one character”Lab 4 file parser →Check argc and streams; skip whitespace before peek.Words, signed integers, missing file, existing output.
“vector”, “iterators”, “at”, standard library allowedLab 7 vector implementation →Use (*it)->draw for a vector of Shape pointers.Iteration and caught out_of_range from at().
“new Derived”, “delete through base pointer”Owning pointer driver →Use a virtual base destructor and delete each owned object once.No leaks or double deletion. Never delete a borrowed local address.

When the question requires separate .hpp / .cpp / main files
Header (.hpp)
Header guard, struct/class declarations, function prototypes, default arguments, inline functions and template definitions. Stack<T> implementations stay visible in the header.
Implementation (.cpp)
Include the header, then write ordinary function bodies and ClassName::method definitions. Do not repeat default arguments.
main.cpp
Include your headers, create objects, call functions and test normal and error cases. Keep exactly one main when combining examples.
Lab 2 grading table
The saved handout confirms 89.1 → A but omits the full grade table. The solution marks its example grade boundaries for comparison with your course outline.
Lab 4 execution
Compile the copied program, then run ./program input.txt output.txt. Output is appended to the named file.
Where does code go? · Class vs inheritance vs main()
Includes + using namespace std;
At the top, before your definitions.
Inside class Base { … };
Base data and methods. private: belongs to that class; protected: also accessible to derived classes; public: callable from outside.
class Derived : public Base
Inherits Base’s accessible interface. Put additional fields and overriding methods inside Derived. Call Base(arguments) in its constructor initializer list.
ReturnType ClassName::method()
Defines a declared method outside its class. It still belongs to that class.
int main()
Creates objects, pushes/enqueues data, calls methods, and uses results. It is outside every class.
Virtual dispatch
A virtual method called through Base* or Base& runs the matching derived override. An ordinary by-value base copy can slice off derived information.

#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

class Person {
private:
    string name;
public:
    Person(string name) : name(name) {}
    string getName() const { return name; }
};
class Student : public Person {
private:
    int id;
public:
    Student(string name, int id) : Person(name), id(id) {}
    int getId() const { return id; }
};

int main() {
    Student s("Ada", 42);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class Shape {
public:
    virtual double getArea() const = 0;
    virtual ~Shape() = default;
};
class Rectangle : public Shape {
    double length, width;
public:
    Rectangle(double l, double w) : length(l), width(w) {}
    double getArea() const override { return length * width; }
};
class Circle : public Shape {
    double radius;
public:
    Circle(double r) : radius(r) {}
    double getArea() const override { return 3.141592653589793 * radius * radius; }
};

int main() {
    Rectangle r(3, 4);
    Circle c(2);
    Shape* shapes[] = {&r, &c};
    double total = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) total += shapes[i]->getArea();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class Account {
protected:
    double balance;
public:
    Account(double b) : balance(b) {}
    virtual void monthlyChange() { balance -= 5; }
    double getBalance() const { return balance; }
    virtual ~Account() = default;
};
class SavingsAccount : public Account {
    double rate;
public:
    SavingsAccount(double b, double r) : Account(b), rate(r) {}
    void monthlyChange() override { balance += balance * rate; }
};

int main() {
    SavingsAccount savings(100, 0.05);
    Account* account = &savings;
    account->monthlyChange();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class Device {
protected:
    double reading;
public:
    Device(double r) : reading(r) {}
    virtual void reset() { reading = 0; }
    double getReading() const { return reading; }
    virtual ~Device() = default;
};
class Sensor : public Device {
    int errors;
public:
    Sensor(double r, int e) : Device(r), errors(e) {}
    void reset() override {
        Device::reset();
        errors = 0;
    }
    int getErrors() const { return errors; }
};

int main() {
    Sensor sensor(12, 3);
    sensor.reset();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class IntSLLNode {
public:
    IntSLLNode(int el, IntSLLNode *ptr = nullptr) { info = el; next = ptr; }
    int info;
    IntSLLNode *next;
};
class IntSLList {
    IntSLLNode *head, *tail;
public:
    IntSLList() { head = tail = nullptr; }
    int isEmpty() { return head == nullptr; }
    void addToHead(int el) {
        head = new IntSLLNode(el, head);
        if (tail == nullptr) tail = head;
    }
    void addToTail(int el) {
        if (tail != nullptr) {
            tail->next = new IntSLLNode(el);
            tail = tail->next;
        } else head = tail = new IntSLLNode(el);
    }
    int deleteFromHead() {
        int el = head->info;
        IntSLLNode *tmp = head;
        if (head == tail) head = tail = nullptr;
        else head = head->next;
        delete tmp;
        return el;
    }
    ~IntSLList() { while (!isEmpty()) deleteFromHead(); }

    IntSLList(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    IntSLList& operator=(const IntSLList&) = delete;
};

int main() {
    IntSLList lst;
    lst.addToHead(20);
    lst.addToHead(10);
    lst.addToTail(30);
    int first = lst.deleteFromHead();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class IntSLLNode {
public:
    IntSLLNode(int el, IntSLLNode *ptr = nullptr) { info = el; next = ptr; }
    int info;
    IntSLLNode *next;
};
class IntSLList {
    IntSLLNode *head, *tail;
public:
    IntSLList() { head = tail = nullptr; }
    int isEmpty() { return head == nullptr; }
    void addToHead(int el) {
        head = new IntSLLNode(el, head);
        if (tail == nullptr) tail = head;
    }
    void addToTail(int el) {
        if (tail != nullptr) {
            tail->next = new IntSLLNode(el);
            tail = tail->next;
        } else head = tail = new IntSLLNode(el);
    }
    int deleteFromHead() {
        int el = head->info;
        IntSLLNode *tmp = head;
        if (head == tail) head = tail = nullptr;
        else head = head->next;
        delete tmp;
        return el;
    }
    ~IntSLList() { while (!isEmpty()) deleteFromHead(); }

    IntSLList(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    IntSLList& operator=(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    int countNodes() const {
        int count = 0;
        for (IntSLLNode* p = head; p != nullptr; p = p->next) ++count;
        return count;
    }
};

int main() {
    IntSLList lst;
    lst.addToTail(10);
    lst.addToTail(20);
    int count = lst.countNodes();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class IntSLLNode {
public:
    IntSLLNode(int el, IntSLLNode *ptr = nullptr) { info = el; next = ptr; }
    int info;
    IntSLLNode *next;
};
class IntSLList {
    IntSLLNode *head, *tail;
public:
    IntSLList() { head = tail = nullptr; }
    int isEmpty() { return head == nullptr; }
    void addToHead(int el) {
        head = new IntSLLNode(el, head);
        if (tail == nullptr) tail = head;
    }
    void addToTail(int el) {
        if (tail != nullptr) {
            tail->next = new IntSLLNode(el);
            tail = tail->next;
        } else head = tail = new IntSLLNode(el);
    }
    int deleteFromHead() {
        int el = head->info;
        IntSLLNode *tmp = head;
        if (head == tail) head = tail = nullptr;
        else head = head->next;
        delete tmp;
        return el;
    }
    ~IntSLList() { while (!isEmpty()) deleteFromHead(); }

    IntSLList(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    IntSLList& operator=(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    bool isInList(int el) const {
        for (IntSLLNode* tmp = head; tmp != nullptr; tmp = tmp->next) {
            if (tmp->info == el) return true;

        return false;

};

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class IntSLLNode {
public:
    IntSLLNode(int el, IntSLLNode *ptr = nullptr) { info = el; next = ptr; }
    int info;
    IntSLLNode *next;
};
class IntSLList {
    IntSLLNode *head, *tail;
public:
    IntSLList() { head = tail = nullptr; }
    int isEmpty() { return head == nullptr; }
    void addToHead(int el) {
        head = new IntSLLNode(el, head);
        if (tail == nullptr) tail = head;
    }
    void addToTail(int el) {
        if (tail != nullptr) {
            tail->next = new IntSLLNode(el);
            tail = tail->next;
        } else head = tail = new IntSLLNode(el);
    }
    int deleteFromHead() {
        int el = head->info;
        IntSLLNode *tmp = head;
        if (head == tail) head = tail = nullptr;
        else head = head->next;
        delete tmp;
        return el;
    }
    ~IntSLList() { while (!isEmpty()) deleteFromHead(); }

    IntSLList(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    IntSLList& operator=(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    int deleteFromTail() {
        int el = tail->info;
        if (head == tail) {
            delete head;
            head = tail = nullptr;
        } else {
            IntSLLNode* tmp = head;
            while (tmp->next != tail) tmp = tmp->next;
            delete tail;
            tail = tmp;
            tail->next = nullptr;
        }
        return el;
    }
};

int main() {
    IntSLList lst;
    lst.addToTail(1);
    lst.addToTail(2);
    int last = lst.deleteFromTail();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class IntSLLNode {
public:
    IntSLLNode(int el, IntSLLNode *ptr = nullptr) { info = el; next = ptr; }
    int info;
    IntSLLNode *next;
};
class IntSLList {
    IntSLLNode *head, *tail;
public:
    IntSLList() { head = tail = nullptr; }
    int isEmpty() { return head == nullptr; }
    void addToHead(int el) {
        head = new IntSLLNode(el, head);
        if (tail == nullptr) tail = head;
    }
    void addToTail(int el) {
        if (tail != nullptr) {
            tail->next = new IntSLLNode(el);
            tail = tail->next;
        } else head = tail = new IntSLLNode(el);
    }
    int deleteFromHead() {
        int el = head->info;
        IntSLLNode *tmp = head;
        if (head == tail) head = tail = nullptr;
        else head = head->next;
        delete tmp;
        return el;
    }
    ~IntSLList() { while (!isEmpty()) deleteFromHead(); }

    IntSLList(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    IntSLList& operator=(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    void deleteNode(int el) {
        IntSLLNode* pred = nullptr;
        IntSLLNode* tmp = head;
        while (tmp != nullptr && tmp->info != el) {
            pred = tmp;
            tmp = tmp->next;
        }
        if (tmp == nullptr) return;
        if (pred == nullptr) head = tmp->next;
        else pred->next = tmp->next;
        if (tmp == tail) tail = pred;
        delete tmp;
    }
};

int main() {
    IntSLList lst;
    lst.addToTail(1); lst.addToTail(2); lst.addToTail(3);
    lst.deleteNode(2);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class IntSLLNode {
public:
    IntSLLNode(int el, IntSLLNode *ptr = nullptr) { info = el; next = ptr; }
    int info;
    IntSLLNode *next;
};
class IntSLList {
    IntSLLNode *head, *tail;
public:
    IntSLList() { head = tail = nullptr; }
    int isEmpty() { return head == nullptr; }
    void addToHead(int el) {
        head = new IntSLLNode(el, head);
        if (tail == nullptr) tail = head;
    }
    void addToTail(int el) {
        if (tail != nullptr) {
            tail->next = new IntSLLNode(el);
            tail = tail->next;
        } else head = tail = new IntSLLNode(el);
    }
    int deleteFromHead() {
        int el = head->info;
        IntSLLNode *tmp = head;
        if (head == tail) head = tail = nullptr;
        else head = head->next;
        delete tmp;
        return el;
    }
    ~IntSLList() { while (!isEmpty()) deleteFromHead(); }

    IntSLList(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    IntSLList& operator=(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    void reverse() {
        IntSLLNode* previous = nullptr;
        IntSLLNode* current = head;
        tail = head;
        while (current != nullptr) {
            IntSLLNode* next = current->next;
            current->next = previous;
            previous = current;
            current = next;
        }
        head = previous;
    }
};

int main() {
    IntSLList lst;
    lst.addToTail(1); lst.addToTail(2); lst.addToTail(3);
    lst.reverse();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <exception>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

class StackException : public exception {
    string message;
public:
    explicit StackException(const string& msg) noexcept : message(msg) {}
    const char* what() const noexcept override { return message.c_str(); }
};

template <class T> class Stack {
private:
    typedef struct stackNode {
        struct stackNode *next;
        T theItem;
    } StackNode;
    StackNode *topOfStack;
    int count;
public:
    Stack() : topOfStack(NULL), count(0) {}
    void push(T item) {
        StackNode *newNode = new StackNode;
        newNode->theItem = item;
        newNode->next = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = newNode;
        ++count;
    }
    T pop(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Pop from empty stack");
        T item = topOfStack->theItem;
        StackNode *old = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = old->next;
        delete old;
        --count;
        return item;
    }
    T top(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Top of empty stack");
        return topOfStack->theItem;
    }
    int size(void) { return count; }
    bool isEmpty(void) { return count == 0; }

    ~Stack() { while (!isEmpty()) pop(); }
    Stack(const Stack&) = delete;
    Stack& operator=(const Stack&) = delete;
};

int main() {
    Stack<int> s;
    s.push(10); s.push(20);
    int removed = s.pop();
    return 0;
}

StackNode / theItem / next
A node holds one item and the link below it.
topOfStack / count
The top node and the current item count.
push
Create a node, link to old top, move top, increment count.
pop
Save the item, advance top, delete the old node, decrement count, return item.
top / isEmpty / size
Inspect without removing; empty access throws StackException.

#include <iostream>
#include <exception>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

class StackException : public exception {
    string message;
public:
    explicit StackException(const string& msg) noexcept : message(msg) {}
    const char* what() const noexcept override { return message.c_str(); }
};

template <class T> class Stack {
private:
    typedef struct stackNode {
        struct stackNode *next;
        T theItem;
    } StackNode;
    StackNode *topOfStack;
    int count;
public:
    Stack() : topOfStack(NULL), count(0) {}
    void push(T item) {
        StackNode *newNode = new StackNode;
        newNode->theItem = item;
        newNode->next = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = newNode;
        ++count;
    }
    T pop(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Pop from empty stack");
        T item = topOfStack->theItem;
        StackNode *old = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = old->next;
        delete old;
        --count;
        return item;
    }
    T top(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Top of empty stack");
        return topOfStack->theItem;
    }
    int size(void) { return count; }
    bool isEmpty(void) { return count == 0; }

    ~Stack() { while (!isEmpty()) pop(); }
    Stack(const Stack&) = delete;
    Stack& operator=(const Stack&) = delete;
};

bool balanced(const string& text) {
    Stack<char> s;
    for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(text.length()); ++i) {
        if (text[i] == '(') s.push('(');
        else if (text[i] == ')') {
            if (s.isEmpty()) return false;
            s.pop();
        }
    }
    return s.isEmpty();
}

int main() {
    bool valid = balanced("(a+(b*c))");
    return 0;
}

#include <string>
using namespace std;

class StackException : public exception {
    string message;
public:
    explicit StackException(const string& msg) noexcept : message(msg) {}
    const char* what() const noexcept override { return message.c_str(); }
};

template <class T> class Stack {
private:
    typedef struct stackNode {
        struct stackNode *next;
        T theItem;
    } StackNode;
    StackNode *topOfStack;
    int count;
public:
    Stack() : topOfStack(NULL), count(0) {}
    void push(T item) {
        StackNode *newNode = new StackNode;
        newNode->theItem = item;
        newNode->next = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = newNode;
        ++count;
    }
    T pop(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Pop from empty stack");
        T item = topOfStack->theItem;
        StackNode *old = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = old->next;
        delete old;
        --count;
        return item;
    }
    T top(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Top of empty stack");
        return topOfStack->theItem;
    }
    int size(void) { return count; }
    bool isEmpty(void) { return count == 0; }

    ~Stack() { while (!isEmpty()) pop(); }
    Stack(const Stack&) = delete;
    Stack& operator=(const Stack&) = delete;
};

void transfer(Stack<int>& source, Stack<int>& destination) {
    while (!source.isEmpty()) destination.push(source.pop());
}

int main() {
    Stack<int> source, destination;
    source.push(1); source.push(2); source.push(3);
    transfer(source, destination);
    return 0;
}

    StackNode *topOfStack;

    Stack() : topOfStack(NULL), count(0) {}
    void push(T item) {
        StackNode *newNode = new StackNode;
        newNode->theItem = item;
        newNode->next = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = newNode;
        ++count;
    }
    T pop(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Pop from empty stack");
        T item = topOfStack->theItem;
        StackNode *old = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = old->next;

class Shape {
public:
    virtual double getArea() const = 0;
    virtual ~Shape() = default;
};
class Rectangle : public Shape {
    double length, width;
public:
    Rectangle(double l, double w) : length(l), width(w) {}
    double getArea() const override { return length * width; }
};

int main() {
    Stack<Shape*> shapes;
    shapes.push(new Rectangle(2, 3));
    shapes.push(new Rectangle(4, 5));
    double total = 0;
    while (!shapes.isEmpty()) {
        Shape* shape = shapes.pop();
        total += shape->getArea();
        delete shape;
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <stdexcept>
using namespace std;

template<class T>
class LinkedQueue {
    struct Node {
        T info;
        Node* next;
        Node(const T& el) : info(el), next(nullptr) {}
    };
    Node *head, *tail;
    int count;
public:
    LinkedQueue() : head(nullptr), tail(nullptr), count(0) {}
    bool isEmpty() const { return head == nullptr; }
    int size() const { return count; }
    void enqueue(const T& el) {
        Node* node = new Node(el);
        if (tail == nullptr) head = node;
        else tail->next = node;
        tail = node;
        ++count;
    }
    T front() const {
        if (isEmpty()) throw runtime_error("Empty queue");
        return head->info;
    }
    T dequeue() {
        if (isEmpty()) throw runtime_error("Empty queue");
        T el = head->info;
        Node* tmp = head;
        head = head->next;
        if (head == nullptr) tail = nullptr;
        delete tmp;
        --count;
        return el;
    }
    ~LinkedQueue() { while (!isEmpty()) dequeue(); }
    LinkedQueue(const LinkedQueue&) = delete;
    LinkedQueue& operator=(const LinkedQueue&) = delete;
};

int main() {
    LinkedQueue<int> q;
    q.enqueue(10); q.enqueue(20);
    int first = q.dequeue();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <list>
using namespace std;

template<class T>
class ListQueue {
public:
	ListQueue() {
	}
	void clear() {
		lst.clear();
	}
	bool isEmpty() const {
		return lst.empty();
	}
	T& front() {
		return lst.front();
	}
	T dequeue() {
		T el = lst.front();
		lst.pop_front();
		return el;
	}
	void enqueue(const T& el) {
		lst.push_back(el);
	}
private:
	list<T> lst;
};

    ListQueue<int> q;
    q.enqueue(10);
    q.enqueue(20);
    int first = q.dequeue();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

template<class T, int size = 100>
class ArrayQueue {
public:
	ArrayQueue() {
		first = last = -1;
	}
	void enqueue(T);
	T dequeue();
	bool isFull() {
		return (first == 0 && last == size-1) || (first == last + 1);
	}
	bool isEmpty() {
		return first == -1;
	}

private:
	int first, last;
	T storage[size];
};

template<class T, int size>
void ArrayQueue<T,size>::enqueue(T el) {
	if (!isFull())
		if (last == size-1 || last == -1) {
			storage[0] = el;
			last = 0;
			if (first == -1)
				first = 0;
		}
		else storage[++last] = el;
	else cout << "Full queue.\n";
}

template<class T, int size>
T ArrayQueue<T,size>::dequeue() {
	T tmp;
	tmp = storage[first];
	if (first == last)
		last = first = -1;
	else if (first == size-1)
		first = 0;
	else first++;
	return tmp;
}

int main() {
    ArrayQueue<int, 3> q;
    q.enqueue(1); q.enqueue(2); q.enqueue(3);
    q.dequeue();
    q.enqueue(4);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <stdexcept>
using namespace std;

template<class T>
class LinkedQueue {
    struct Node {
        T info;
        Node* next;
        Node(const T& el) : info(el), next(nullptr) {}
    };
    Node *head, *tail;
    int count;
public:
    LinkedQueue() : head(nullptr), tail(nullptr), count(0) {}
    bool isEmpty() const { return head == nullptr; }
    int size() const { return count; }
    void enqueue(const T& el) {
        Node* node = new Node(el);
        if (tail == nullptr) head = node;
        else tail->next = node;
        tail = node;
        ++count;
    }
    T front() const {
        if (isEmpty()) throw runtime_error("Empty queue");
        return head->info;
    }
    T dequeue() {
        if (isEmpty()) throw runtime_error("Empty queue");
        T el = head->info;
        Node* tmp = head;
        head = head->next;
        if (head == nullptr) tail = nullptr;
        delete tmp;
        --count;
        return el;
    }
    ~LinkedQueue() { while (!isEmpty()) dequeue(); }
    LinkedQueue(const LinkedQueue&) = delete;
    LinkedQueue& operator=(const LinkedQueue&) = delete;
};

struct Job { int id; double duration; };

int main() {
    LinkedQueue<Job> jobs;
    jobs.enqueue(Job{101, 2.5});
    jobs.enqueue(Job{102, 1.0});
    Job next = jobs.dequeue();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <stdexcept>
using namespace std;

template<class T>
class LinkedQueue {
    struct Node {
        T info;
        Node* next;
        Node(const T& el) : info(el), next(nullptr) {}
    };
    Node *head, *tail;
    int count;
public:
    LinkedQueue() : head(nullptr), tail(nullptr), count(0) {}
    bool isEmpty() const { return head == nullptr; }
    int size() const { return count; }
    void enqueue(const T& el) {
        Node* node = new Node(el);
        if (tail == nullptr) head = node;
        else tail->next = node;
        tail = node;
        ++count;
    }
    T front() const {
        if (isEmpty()) throw runtime_error("Empty queue");
        return head->info;
    }
    T dequeue() {
        if (isEmpty()) throw runtime_error("Empty queue");
        T el = head->info;
        Node* tmp = head;
        head = head->next;
        if (head == nullptr) tail = nullptr;
        delete tmp;
        --count;
        return el;
    }
    ~LinkedQueue() { while (!isEmpty()) dequeue(); }
    LinkedQueue(const LinkedQueue&) = delete;
    LinkedQueue& operator=(const LinkedQueue&) = delete;
};

template<class T>
void rotate(LinkedQueue<T>& q) {
    if (!q.isEmpty()) q.enqueue(q.dequeue());
}

int main() {
    LinkedQueue<int> q;
    q.enqueue(1); q.enqueue(2); q.enqueue(3);
    rotate(q);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <exception>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

template<class T>
class LinkedQueue {
    struct Node {
        T info;
        Node* next;
        Node(const T& el) : info(el), next(nullptr) {}
    };
    Node *head, *tail;
    int count;
public:
    LinkedQueue() : head(nullptr), tail(nullptr), count(0) {}
    bool isEmpty() const { return head == nullptr; }
    int size() const { return count; }
    void enqueue(const T& el) {
        Node* node = new Node(el);
        if (tail == nullptr) head = node;
        else tail->next = node;
        tail = node;
        ++count;
    }
    T front() const {
        if (isEmpty()) throw runtime_error("Empty queue");
        return head->info;
    }
    T dequeue() {
        if (isEmpty()) throw runtime_error("Empty queue");
        T el = head->info;
        Node* tmp = head;
        head = head->next;
        if (head == nullptr) tail = nullptr;
        delete tmp;
        --count;
        return el;
    }
    ~LinkedQueue() { while (!isEmpty()) dequeue(); }
    LinkedQueue(const LinkedQueue&) = delete;
    LinkedQueue& operator=(const LinkedQueue&) = delete;
};
class StackException : public exception {
    string message;
public:
    explicit StackException(const string& msg) noexcept : message(msg) {}
    const char* what() const noexcept override { return message.c_str(); }
};

template <class T> class Stack {
private:
    typedef struct stackNode {
        struct stackNode *next;
        T theItem;
    } StackNode;
    StackNode *topOfStack;
    int count;
public:
    Stack() : topOfStack(NULL), count(0) {}
    void push(T item) {
        StackNode *newNode = new StackNode;
        newNode->theItem = item;
        newNode->next = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = newNode;
        ++count;
    }
    T pop(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Pop from empty stack");
        T item = topOfStack->theItem;
        StackNode *old = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = old->next;
        delete old;
        --count;
        return item;
    }
    T top(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Top of empty stack");
        return topOfStack->theItem;
    }
    int size(void) { return count; }
    bool isEmpty(void) { return count == 0; }

    ~Stack() { while (!isEmpty()) pop(); }
    Stack(const Stack&) = delete;
    Stack& operator=(const Stack&) = delete;
};

void reverseQueue(LinkedQueue<int>& q) {
    Stack<int> s;
    while (!q.isEmpty()) s.push(q.dequeue());
    while (!s.isEmpty()) q.enqueue(s.pop());
}

int main() {
    LinkedQueue<int> q;
    q.enqueue(1); q.enqueue(2); q.enqueue(3);
    reverseQueue(q);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <stdexcept>
using namespace std;

const double PI = 3.14159265358979323846;
void getUserInput(double& radius, double& pegDist, double& spacing) {
    cout << "Radius, peg distance, maximum spacing: ";
    if (!(cin >> radius >> pegDist >> spacing)) throw invalid_argument("Use numbers");
}
int getNumberOfLights(double radius, double pegDist, double spacing) {
    if (radius <= 0 || pegDist <= 0 || pegDist > 2*radius || spacing <= 0)
        throw invalid_argument("Require R>0, 0<chord<=2R, spacing>0");
    double arcAngle = 2 * asin(pegDist / (2 * radius));
    return static_cast<int>(ceil(radius * arcAngle / spacing)) + 1;
}
void calculateLightPositions(double radius, double pegDist, int numLights,
                             double angles[], double distances[]) {
    double halfArcAngle = asin(pegDist / (2 * radius));
    angles[0] = distances[0] = 0;
    for (int i=1; i<numLights; ++i) {
        double halfCentralAngle = halfArcAngle * i / (numLights-1);
        angles[i] = halfArcAngle - halfCentralAngle;
        distances[i] = 2 * radius * sin(halfCentralAngle);
    }
}
void outputResults(const double angles[], const double distances[], int numLights) {
    cout << numLights << " streetlights\n";
    for (int i=0; i<numLights; ++i) {
        cout << i+1 << ": distance=" << distances[i];
        if (i>0) cout << ", angle=" << angles[i]*180/PI << " degrees";
        cout << '\n';
    }
}

int main() {
    double radius, pegDist, spacing;
    try {
        getUserInput(radius, pegDist, spacing);
        int numLights = getNumberOfLights(radius, pegDist, spacing);
        double* angles = new double[numLights];
        double* distances = new double[numLights];
        calculateLightPositions(radius, pegDist, numLights, angles, distances);
        outputResults(angles, distances, numLights);
        delete[] angles;
        delete[] distances;
    } catch (const exception& e) { cout << e.what() << '\n'; }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
using namespace std;

const double MIN_MARK=0, MAX_MARK=100, MIN_WEIGHT=1, MAX_WEIGHT=50;
const double REQUIRED_WEIGHT=100, WEIGHT_TOLERANCE=0.1;
bool getValidNumber(string prompt, double* value, const double min, const double max) {
    while (true) {
        cout << prompt;
        if (!(cin >> *value)) {
            cin.clear();
            cin.ignore(numeric_limits<streamsize>::max(), '\n');
            return false;
        }
        if (*value >= min && *value <= max) return true;
        cout << "Number is out of range. Try again.\n";
    }
}
string gradeFromMark(const double mark) {
    // Check these example boundaries against your course outline.
    if (mark>=90) return "A+";
    else if (mark>=85) return "A";
    else if (mark>=80) return "A-";
    else if (mark>=77) return "B+";
    else if (mark>=73) return "B";
    else if (mark>=70) return "B-";
    else if (mark>=65) return "C+";
    else if (mark>=60) return "C";
    else if (mark>=50) return "D";
    else return "F";
}

int main() {
    double mark, weight, total=0, totalWeight=0;
    while (getValidNumber("Mark: ", &mark, MIN_MARK, MAX_MARK)) {
        if (!getValidNumber("Weight: ", &weight, MIN_WEIGHT, MAX_WEIGHT)) break;
        total += mark * weight / 100.0;
        totalWeight += weight;
    }
    cout << "Input data terminated.\n";
    if (abs(totalWeight-REQUIRED_WEIGHT) <= WEIGHT_TOLERANCE + 1e-9)
        cout << "Mark is " << total << " and grade is " << gradeFromMark(total) << '\n';
    else cout << "Weights must total 100%.\n";
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
using namespace std;

const double PI=3.14159265358979323846;
struct SphericalCoords { double radius, azimuth, inclination; };
inline double getRadius(double x, double y, double z=0) {
    return sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z);
}
double* sphericalToRectangular(double r, double azimuth, double inclination=PI/2) {
    if (r<0) throw invalid_argument("Negative radius");
    return new double[3]{r*sin(inclination)*cos(azimuth),
                         r*sin(inclination)*sin(azimuth), r*cos(inclination)};
}
SphericalCoords rectangularToSpherical(double x, double y, double z=0) {
    double r=getRadius(x,y,z);
    if (r==0) return {0,0,0}; // Direction undefined: choose zero angles.
    return {r, atan2(y,x), acos(max(-1.0,min(1.0,z/r)))};
}

int main() {
    SphericalCoords s=rectangularToSpherical(3,4);
    double* xyz=sphericalToRectangular(s.radius,s.azimuth,s.inclination);
    cout << s.radius << " -> " << xyz[0] << ", " << xyz[1] << ", " << xyz[2] << '\n';
    delete[] xyz;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <cctype>
#include <stdexcept>
using namespace std;

void processText(istream& input, ostream& output) {
    while (input >> ws && input.peek()!=char_traits<char>::eof()) {
        int first=input.peek();
        if (isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(first)) || first=='+' || first=='-') {
            int number;
            if (!(input >> number)) throw runtime_error("Invalid integer");
            output << "Found an integer: " << number << '\n';
        } else {
            string word; input >> word;
            output << "Found a " << word.length() << " character word: " << word << '\n';
        }
    }
    if (input.bad() || !output) throw runtime_error("I/O error");
}

int main(int argc, char* argv[]) {
    if (argc!=3) { cout << "Usage: program input.txt output.txt\n"; return 1; }
    try {
        ifstream input(argv[1]);
        ofstream output(argv[2],ios::app);
        if (!input || !output) throw runtime_error("Could not open files");
        processText(input,output);
    } catch (const exception& e) { cout << e.what() << '\n'; return 1; }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

class Controller {
public:
    static constexpr double deltaT=1.0;
    virtual double controlStep(double plantOutput, double setpoint)=0;
    virtual ~Controller()=default;
};
class ProportionalController : public Controller {
    double kc;
public:
    ProportionalController(double propGain) : kc(propGain) {}
    double controlStep(double plantOutput, double setpoint) override {
        double error=setpoint-plantOutput;
        return setpoint+kc*error;
    }
};
class PID_Controller : public Controller {
    double kc,ti,td,q,previousOutput;
public:
    PID_Controller(double propGain,double integralTime,double derivativeTime)
        : kc(propGain),ti(integralTime),td(derivativeTime),q(0),previousOutput(0) {
        if (ti<=0 || td<0) throw invalid_argument("Require ti>0 and td>=0");
    }
    double controlStep(double plantOutput, double setpoint) override {
        double error=setpoint-plantOutput;
        q=0.9*q+0.1*error;
        double result=setpoint+kc*(error+deltaT/ti*q-td/deltaT*(plantOutput-previousOutput));
        previousOutput=plantOutput;
        return result;
    }
};
class Plant {
    int order;
    vector<double> b,a,state;
public:
    Plant(const double num[],const double den[],int order)
        : order(order),b(num,num+order+1),a(den,den+order+1),state(order+1,0) {}
    double plantResponse(double input) {
        double y=b[0]*input+state[0];
        for (int k=0;k<order;++k) state[k]=state[k+1]+input*b[k+1]-y*a[k+1];
        return y;
    }
};

int main() {
    const double num[]={0.023018459508916,0.046036919017832,0.023018459508916};
    const double den[]={1,-1.618519638615533,0.710593476651197};
    Plant plant(num,den,2);
    PID_Controller pidController(0.5,25,2.5);
    Controller* controller=&pidController;
    double y=plant.plantResponse(0);
    cout << "Y = [\n";
    for (int step=0;step<50;++step) {
        double input=controller->controlStep(y,1);
        y=plant.plantResponse(input);
        cout << input << " " << y << '\n';
    }
    cout << "];\n";
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <exception>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

class Shape {
    int x,y;
protected:
    virtual void printMe(ostream& out) const=0;
public:
    Shape(int xLoc,int yLoc) : x(xLoc),y(yLoc) {}
    virtual ~Shape()=default;
    void moveTo(int x,int y) { this->x=x; this->y=y; }
    int getX() const { return x; }
    int getY() const { return y; }
    virtual void draw() const=0;
    friend ostream& operator<<(ostream& out,const Shape& shape) {
        shape.printMe(out); return out;
    }
};
class Rectangle : public Shape {
    double length,width;
protected:
    void printMe(ostream& out) const override { out << "Rectangle " << length << " x " << width; }
public:
    Rectangle(double l,double w,int x,int y) : Shape(x,y),length(l),width(w) {}
    double getLength() const { return length; }
    double getWidth() const { return width; }
    void draw() const override { cout << *this << " at " << getX() << "," << getY() << '\n'; }
};
class Circle : public Shape {
    double radius;
protected:
    void printMe(ostream& out) const override { out << "Circle radius " << radius; }
public:
    Circle(double r,int x,int y) : Shape(x,y),radius(r) {}
    double getRadius() const { return radius; }
    void draw() const override { cout << *this << " at " << getX() << "," << getY() << '\n'; }
};
class Square : public Rectangle {
protected:
    void printMe(ostream& out) const override { out << "Square side " << getLength(); }
public:
    Square(double side,int x,int y) : Rectangle(side,side,x,y) {}
};

class StackException : public exception {
    string message;
public:
    explicit StackException(const string& msg) noexcept : message(msg) {}
    const char* what() const noexcept override { return message.c_str(); }
};

template <class T> class Stack {
private:
    typedef struct stackNode {
        struct stackNode *next;
        T theItem;
    } StackNode;
    StackNode *topOfStack;
    int count;
public:
    Stack() : topOfStack(NULL), count(0) {}
    void push(T item) {
        StackNode *newNode = new StackNode;
        newNode->theItem = item;
        newNode->next = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = newNode;
        ++count;
    }
    T pop(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Pop from empty stack");
        T item = topOfStack->theItem;
        StackNode *old = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = old->next;
        delete old;
        --count;
        return item;
    }
    T top(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Top of empty stack");
        return topOfStack->theItem;
    }
    int size(void) { return count; }
    bool isEmpty(void) { return count == 0; }

    ~Stack() { while (!isEmpty()) pop(); }
    Stack(const Stack&) = delete;
    Stack& operator=(const Stack&) = delete;
};

int main() {
    Circle circle(2,0,0); Rectangle rectangle(3,4,1,1); Square square(5,2,2);
    Stack<Shape*> shapes;
    try {
        shapes.push(&circle); shapes.push(&rectangle); shapes.push(&square);
        cout << "Size " << shapes.size() << ", top " << *shapes.top() << '\n';
        while (!shapes.isEmpty()) shapes.pop()->draw();
        shapes.pop(); // Deliberate underflow to test the catch.
    } catch (const StackException& e) { cout << e.what() << '\n'; }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <stdexcept>
using namespace std;

class Shape {
    int x,y;
protected:
    virtual void printMe(ostream& out) const=0;
public:
    Shape(int xLoc,int yLoc) : x(xLoc),y(yLoc) {}
    virtual ~Shape()=default;
    void moveTo(int x,int y) { this->x=x; this->y=y; }
    int getX() const { return x; }
    int getY() const { return y; }
    virtual void draw() const=0;
    friend ostream& operator<<(ostream& out,const Shape& shape) {
        shape.printMe(out); return out;
    }
};
class Rectangle : public Shape {
    double length,width;
protected:
    void printMe(ostream& out) const override { out << "Rectangle " << length << " x " << width; }
public:
    Rectangle(double l,double w,int x,int y) : Shape(x,y),length(l),width(w) {}
    double getLength() const { return length; }
    double getWidth() const { return width; }
    void draw() const override { cout << *this << " at " << getX() << "," << getY() << '\n'; }
};
class Circle : public Shape {
    double radius;
protected:
    void printMe(ostream& out) const override { out << "Circle radius " << radius; }
public:
    Circle(double r,int x,int y) : Shape(x,y),radius(r) {}
    double getRadius() const { return radius; }
    void draw() const override { cout << *this << " at " << getX() << "," << getY() << '\n'; }
};
class Square : public Rectangle {
protected:
    void printMe(ostream& out) const override { out << "Square side " << getLength(); }
public:
    Square(double side,int x,int y) : Rectangle(side,side,x,y) {}
};

int main() {
    Circle circle(2,0,0); Rectangle rectangle(3,4,1,1); Square square(5,2,2);
    vector<Shape*> shapes;
    try {
        shapes.push_back(&circle); shapes.push_back(&rectangle);
        shapes[0]->moveTo(2,3);
        shapes.front()->draw(); shapes.back()->draw();
        cout << shapes.size() << " " << shapes.capacity() << " " << shapes.max_size() << '\n';
        shapes.insert(shapes.begin()+1,&square);
        for (vector<Shape*>::iterator it=shapes.begin();it!=shapes.end();++it) (*it)->draw();
        shapes.pop_back();
        shapes.at(0)->draw();
        shapes.at(shapes.size()); // Deliberate checked out-of-range access.
    } catch (const out_of_range& e) { cout << e.what() << '\n'; }
    return 0;
}

template<class T>
class LinkedQueue {
    struct Node {
        T info;
        Node* next;
        Node(const T& el) : info(el), next(nullptr) {}
    };
    Node *head, *tail;
    int count;
public:
    LinkedQueue() : head(nullptr), tail(nullptr), count(0) {}
    bool isEmpty() const { return head == nullptr; }
    int size() const { return count; }
    void enqueue(const T& el) {
        Node* node = new Node(el);
        if (tail == nullptr) head = node;
        else tail->next = node;
        tail = node;
        ++count;
    }
    T front() const {
        if (isEmpty()) throw runtime_error("Empty queue");
        return head->info;
    }
    T dequeue() {
        if (isEmpty()) throw runtime_error("Empty queue");
        T el = head->info;
        Node* tmp = head;
        head = head->next;
        if (head == nullptr) tail = nullptr;
        delete tmp;
        --count;
        return el;
    }
    ~LinkedQueue() { while (!isEmpty()) dequeue(); }
    LinkedQueue(const LinkedQueue&) = delete;
    LinkedQueue& operator=(const LinkedQueue&) = delete;
};

int main() {
    Circle c(2,0,0); Square s(3,1,1); LinkedQueue<Shape*> q; q.enqueue(&c); q.enqueue(&s); while(!q.isEmpty()) q.dequeue()->draw();
    return 0;
}

class StackException : public exception {
    string message;
public:
    explicit StackException(const string& msg) noexcept : message(msg) {}
    const char* what() const noexcept override { return message.c_str(); }
};

template <class T> class Stack {
private:
    typedef struct stackNode {
        struct stackNode *next;
        T theItem;
    } StackNode;
    StackNode *topOfStack;
    int count;
public:
    Stack() : topOfStack(NULL), count(0) {}
    void push(T item) {
        StackNode *newNode = new StackNode;
        newNode->theItem = item;
        newNode->next = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = newNode;
        ++count;
    }
    T pop(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Pop from empty stack");
        T item = topOfStack->theItem;
        StackNode *old = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = old->next;
        delete old;
        --count;
        return item;
    }
    T top(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Top of empty stack");
        return topOfStack->theItem;
    }
    int size(void) { return count; }
    bool isEmpty(void) { return count == 0; }

    ~Stack() { while (!isEmpty()) pop(); }
    Stack(const Stack&) = delete;
    Stack& operator=(const Stack&) = delete;
};

int main() {
    Stack<Shape*> shapes; shapes.push(new Circle(2,0,0)); shapes.push(new Square(3,0,0)); while(!shapes.isEmpty()) { Shape* p=shapes.pop(); p->draw(); delete p; }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

class Controller {
public:
    static constexpr double deltaT=1.0;
    virtual double controlStep(double plantOutput, double setpoint)=0;
    virtual ~Controller()=default;
};
class ProportionalController : public Controller {
    double kc;
public:
    ProportionalController(double propGain) : kc(propGain) {}
    double controlStep(double plantOutput, double setpoint) override {
        double error=setpoint-plantOutput;
        return setpoint+kc*error;
    }
};
class PID_Controller : public Controller {
    double kc,ti,td,q,previousOutput;
public:
    PID_Controller(double propGain,double integralTime,double derivativeTime)
        : kc(propGain),ti(integralTime),td(derivativeTime),q(0),previousOutput(0) {
        if (ti<=0 || td<0) throw invalid_argument("Require ti>0 and td>=0");
    }
    double controlStep(double plantOutput, double setpoint) override {
        double error=setpoint-plantOutput;
        q=0.9*q+0.1*error;
        double result=setpoint+kc*(error+deltaT/ti*q-td/deltaT*(plantOutput-previousOutput));
        previousOutput=plantOutput;
        return result;
    }
};
class Plant {
    int order;
    vector<double> b,a,state;
public:
    Plant(const double num[],const double den[],int order)
        : order(order),b(num,num+order+1),a(den,den+order+1),state(order+1,0) {}
    double plantResponse(double input) {
        double y=b[0]*input+state[0];
        for (int k=0;k<order;++k) state[k]=state[k+1]+input*b[k+1]-y*a[k+1];
        return y;
    }
};

int main() {
    ProportionalController proportional(0.3); PID_Controller pid(0.5,25,2.5); Controller* c=&proportional; cout << c->controlStep(0,1) << endl; c=&pid; cout << c->controlStep(0,1) << endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <cmath>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

class Controller {
public:
    static constexpr double deltaT=1.0;
    virtual double controlStep(double plantOutput, double setpoint)=0;
    virtual ~Controller()=default;
};
class ProportionalController : public Controller {
    double kc;
public:

    double controlStep(double plantOutput, double setpoint) override {
        double error=setpoint-plantOutput;
        return setpoint+kc*error;
    }
};
class PID_Controller : public Controller {
    double kc,ti,td,q,previousOutput;
public:
    PID_Controller(double propGain,double integralTime,double derivativeTime)
        : kc(propGain),ti(integralTime),td(derivativeTime),q(0),previousOutput(0) {
        if (ti<=0 || td<0) throw invalid_argument("Require ti>0 and td>=0");
    }
    double controlStep(double plantOutput, double setpoint) override {
        double error=setpoint-plantOutput;
        q=0.9*q+0.1*error;
        double result=setpoint+kc*(error+deltaT/ti*q-td/deltaT*(plantOutput-previousOutput));
        previousOutput=plantOutput;
        return result;
    }
};
class Plant {
    int order;
    vector<double> b,a,state;
public:
    Plant(const double num[],const double den[],int order)
        : order(order),b(num,num+order+1),a(den,den+order+1),state(order+1,0) {}
    double plantResponse(double input) {
        double y=b[0]*input+state[0];
        for (int k=0;k<order;++k) state[k]=state[k+1]+input*b[k+1]-y*a[k+1];
        return y;
    }
};
class LimitedController : public ProportionalController {
    double low,high;
public:
    LimitedController(double gain,double low,double high)
        : ProportionalController(gain),low(low),high(high) {
        if (low>high) throw invalid_argument("Reversed limits");
    }
    double controlStep(double plantOutput,double setpoint) override {
        double result=ProportionalController::controlStep(plantOutput,setpoint);
        if (result<low) return low;
        if (result>high) return high;
        return result;
    }
};

    LimitedController limited(2,0,1); Controller* c=&limited; cout << c->controlStep(0,1) << endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <stdexcept>
using namespace std;

class Filter {
public:
    virtual double update(double input)=0;
    virtual ~Filter()=default;
};
class LeakyFilter : public Filter {
    double alpha,previous;
public:
    LeakyFilter(double alpha) : alpha(alpha),previous(0) {
        if(alpha<0 || alpha>1) throw invalid_argument("alpha must be in [0,1]");
    }
    double update(double input) override {
        previous=alpha*previous+(1-alpha)*input;
        return previous;
    }
    void reset() { previous=0; }
};

int main() {
    LeakyFilter f(0.5); Filter& filter=f; cout << filter.update(10) << " " << filter.update(10) << endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class IntSLLNode {
public:
    IntSLLNode(int el, IntSLLNode *ptr = nullptr) { info = el; next = ptr; }
    int info;
    IntSLLNode *next;
};
class IntSLList {
    IntSLLNode *head, *tail;
public:
    int sum() const {
        int total=0;
        for(IntSLLNode* p=head;p!=nullptr;p=p->next) total+=p->info;
        return total;
    }
    double average() const {
        int total=0,n=0;
        for(IntSLLNode* p=head;p!=nullptr;p=p->next) {total+=p->info;++n;}
        return n==0 ? 0.0 : static_cast<double>(total)/n;
    }
    IntSLList() { head = tail = nullptr; }
    int isEmpty() { return head == nullptr; }
    void addToHead(int el) {
        head = new IntSLLNode(el, head);
        if (tail == nullptr) tail = head;
    }
    void addToTail(int el) {
        if (tail != nullptr) {
            tail->next = new IntSLLNode(el);
            tail = tail->next;
        } else head = tail = new IntSLLNode(el);
    }
    int deleteFromHead() {
        int el = head->info;
        IntSLLNode *tmp = head;
        if (head == tail) head = tail = nullptr;
        else head = head->next;
        delete tmp;
        return el;
    }
    ~IntSLList() { while (!isEmpty()) deleteFromHead(); }

    IntSLList(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    IntSLList& operator=(const IntSLList&) = delete;
};

int main() {
    IntSLList list; list.addToTail(3); list.addToTail(4); cout << list.sum() << " " << list.average() << endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class IntSLLNode {
public:
    IntSLLNode(int el, IntSLLNode *ptr = nullptr) { info = el; next = ptr; }
    int info;
    IntSLLNode *next;
};
class IntSLList {
    IntSLLNode *head, *tail;
public:
    bool insertAfter(int target,int el) {
        IntSLLNode* p=head;
        while(p!=nullptr && p->info!=target) p=p->next;
        if(p==nullptr) return false;
        p->next=new IntSLLNode(el,p->next);
        if(tail==p) tail=p->next;
        return true;
    }
    IntSLList() { head = tail = nullptr; }
    int isEmpty() { return head == nullptr; }
    void addToHead(int el) {
        head = new IntSLLNode(el, head);
        if (tail == nullptr) tail = head;
    }
    void addToTail(int el) {
        if (tail != nullptr) {
            tail->next = new IntSLLNode(el);
            tail = tail->next;
        } else head = tail = new IntSLLNode(el);
    }
    int deleteFromHead() {
        int el = head->info;
        IntSLLNode *tmp = head;
        if (head == tail) head = tail = nullptr;
        else head = head->next;
        delete tmp;
        return el;
    }
    ~IntSLList() { while (!isEmpty()) deleteFromHead(); }

    IntSLList(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    IntSLList& operator=(const IntSLList&) = delete;
};

int main() {
    IntSLList list; list.addToTail(10); list.addToTail(30); list.insertAfter(10,20);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

class IntSLLNode {
public:
    IntSLLNode(int el, IntSLLNode *ptr = nullptr) { info = el; next = ptr; }
    int info;
    IntSLLNode *next;
};
class IntSLList {
    IntSLLNode *head, *tail;
public:
    void insertSorted(int el) {
        if(head==nullptr || el<=head->info) {addToHead(el);return;}
        IntSLLNode* p=head;
        while(p->next!=nullptr && p->next->info<el) p=p->next;
        p->next=new IntSLLNode(el,p->next);
        if(p==tail) tail=p->next;
    }
    IntSLList() { head = tail = nullptr; }
    int isEmpty() { return head == nullptr; }
    void addToHead(int el) {
        head = new IntSLLNode(el, head);
        if (tail == nullptr) tail = head;
    }
    void addToTail(int el) {
        if (tail != nullptr) {
            tail->next = new IntSLLNode(el);
            tail = tail->next;
        } else head = tail = new IntSLLNode(el);
    }
    int deleteFromHead() {
        int el = head->info;
        IntSLLNode *tmp = head;
        if (head == tail) head = tail = nullptr;
        else head = head->next;
        delete tmp;
        return el;
    }
    ~IntSLList() { while (!isEmpty()) deleteFromHead(); }

    IntSLList(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    IntSLList& operator=(const IntSLList&) = delete;
};

int main() {
    IntSLList list; for(int v:{7,2,5,2}) list.insertSorted(v);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class IntSLLNode {
public:
    IntSLLNode(int el, IntSLLNode *ptr = nullptr) { info = el; next = ptr; }
    int info;
    IntSLLNode *next;
};
class IntSLList {
    IntSLLNode *head, *tail;
public:
    int removeAll(int target) {
        int removed=0;
        while(head!=nullptr && head->info==target) {deleteFromHead();++removed;}
        IntSLLNode* p=head;
        while(p!=nullptr && p->next!=nullptr) {
            if(p->next->info==target) {
                IntSLLNode* old=p->next;
                p->next=old->next;
                if(old==tail) tail=p;
                delete old; ++removed;
            } else p=p->next;
        }
        return removed;
    }
    IntSLList() { head = tail = nullptr; }
    int isEmpty() { return head == nullptr; }
    void addToHead(int el) {
        head = new IntSLLNode(el, head);
        if (tail == nullptr) tail = head;
    }
    void addToTail(int el) {
        if (tail != nullptr) {
            tail->next = new IntSLLNode(el);
            tail = tail->next;
        } else head = tail = new IntSLLNode(el);
    }
    int deleteFromHead() {
        int el = head->info;
        IntSLLNode *tmp = head;
        if (head == tail) head = tail = nullptr;
        else head = head->next;
        delete tmp;
        return el;
    }
    ~IntSLList() { while (!isEmpty()) deleteFromHead(); }

    IntSLList(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    IntSLList& operator=(const IntSLList&) = delete;
};

int main() {
    IntSLList list; for(int v:{2,2,3,2,4,2}) list.addToTail(v); cout << list.removeAll(2) << endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <exception>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

class StackException : public exception {
    string message;
public:
    explicit StackException(const string& msg) noexcept : message(msg) {}
    const char* what() const noexcept override { return message.c_str(); }
};

template <class T> class Stack {
private:
    typedef struct stackNode {
        struct stackNode *next;
        T theItem;
    } StackNode;
    StackNode *topOfStack;
    int count;
public:
    Stack() : topOfStack(NULL), count(0) {}
    void push(T item) {
        StackNode *newNode = new StackNode;
        newNode->theItem = item;
        newNode->next = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = newNode;
        ++count;
    }
    T pop(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Pop from empty stack");
        T item = topOfStack->theItem;
        StackNode *old = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = old->next;
        delete old;
        --count;
        return item;
    }
    T top(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Top of empty stack");
        return topOfStack->theItem;
    }
    int size(void) { return count; }
    bool isEmpty(void) { return count == 0; }

    ~Stack() { while (!isEmpty()) pop(); }
    Stack(const Stack&) = delete;
    Stack& operator=(const Stack&) = delete;
};

void copyStack(Stack<int>& source,Stack<int>& destination) {
    if(!destination.isEmpty()) throw StackException("Destination must start empty");
    Stack<int> temporary;
    while(!source.isEmpty()) temporary.push(source.pop());
    while(!temporary.isEmpty()) {
        int value=temporary.pop();
        source.push(value); destination.push(value);
    }
}

int main() {
    Stack<int> source,destination; source.push(1);source.push(2);source.push(3);copyStack(source,destination);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <exception>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <stdexcept>
using namespace std;

class StackException : public exception {
    string message;
public:
    explicit StackException(const string& msg) noexcept : message(msg) {}
    const char* what() const noexcept override { return message.c_str(); }
};

template <class T> class Stack {
private:
    typedef struct stackNode {
        struct stackNode *next;
        T theItem;
    } StackNode;
    StackNode *topOfStack;
    int count;
public:
    Stack() : topOfStack(NULL), count(0) {}
    void push(T item) {
        StackNode *newNode = new StackNode;
        newNode->theItem = item;
        newNode->next = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = newNode;
        ++count;
    }
    T pop(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Pop from empty stack");
        T item = topOfStack->theItem;
        StackNode *old = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = old->next;
        delete old;
        --count;
        return item;
    }
    T top(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Top of empty stack");
        return topOfStack->theItem;
    }
    int size(void) { return count; }
    bool isEmpty(void) { return count == 0; }

    ~Stack() { while (!isEmpty()) pop(); }
    Stack(const Stack&) = delete;
    Stack& operator=(const Stack&) = delete;
};

int evaluatePostfix(const string& expression) {
    istringstream input(expression);
    Stack<int> values;
    string token;
    while(input>>token) {
        if(token=="+" || token=="-" || token=="*") {
            if(values.size()<2) throw invalid_argument("Missing operand");
            int right=values.pop(),left=values.pop();
            if(token=="+") values.push(left+right);
            else if(token=="-") values.push(left-right);
            else values.push(left*right);
        } else {
            size_t used=0;
            int value=stoi(token,&used);
            if(used!=token.size()) throw invalid_argument("Invalid number");
            values.push(value);
        }
    }
    if(values.size()!=1) throw invalid_argument("Invalid expression");
    return values.pop();
}

int main() {
    cout << evaluatePostfix("3 4 + 2 *") << endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <exception>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

class StackException : public exception {
    string message;
public:
    explicit StackException(const string& msg) noexcept : message(msg) {}
    const char* what() const noexcept override { return message.c_str(); }
};

template <class T> class Stack {
private:
    typedef struct stackNode {
        struct stackNode *next;
        T theItem;
    } StackNode;
    StackNode *topOfStack;
    int count;
public:
    Stack() : topOfStack(NULL), count(0) {}
    void push(T item) {
        StackNode *newNode = new StackNode;
        newNode->theItem = item;
        newNode->next = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = newNode;
        ++count;
    }
    T pop(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Pop from empty stack");
        T item = topOfStack->theItem;
        StackNode *old = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = old->next;
        delete old;
        --count;
        return item;
    }
    T top(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Top of empty stack");
        return topOfStack->theItem;
    }
    int size(void) { return count; }
    bool isEmpty(void) { return count == 0; }

    ~Stack() { while (!isEmpty()) pop(); }
    Stack(const Stack&) = delete;
    Stack& operator=(const Stack&) = delete;
};

int minimum(Stack<int>& source) {
    if(source.isEmpty()) throw StackException("No minimum of empty stack");
    int result=source.top();
    Stack<int> temporary;
    while(!source.isEmpty()) {
        int value=source.pop();
        if(value<result) result=value;
        temporary.push(value);
    }
    while(!temporary.isEmpty()) source.push(temporary.pop());
    return result;
}

int main() {
    Stack<int> s;for(int v:{4,1,7})s.push(v);cout << minimum(s) << endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <stdexcept>
using namespace std;

template<class T>
class LinkedQueue {
    struct Node {
        T info;
        Node* next;
        Node(const T& el) : info(el), next(nullptr) {}
    };
    Node *head, *tail;
    int count;
public:
    LinkedQueue() : head(nullptr), tail(nullptr), count(0) {}
    bool isEmpty() const { return head == nullptr; }
    int size() const { return count; }
    void enqueue(const T& el) {
        Node* node = new Node(el);
        if (tail == nullptr) head = node;
        else tail->next = node;
        tail = node;
        ++count;
    }
    T front() const {
        if (isEmpty()) throw runtime_error("Empty queue");
        return head->info;
    }
    T dequeue() {
        if (isEmpty()) throw runtime_error("Empty queue");
        T el = head->info;
        Node* tmp = head;
        head = head->next;
        if (head == nullptr) tail = nullptr;
        delete tmp;
        --count;
        return el;
    }
    ~LinkedQueue() { while (!isEmpty()) dequeue(); }
    LinkedQueue(const LinkedQueue&) = delete;
    LinkedQueue& operator=(const LinkedQueue&) = delete;
};

int removeValue(LinkedQueue<int>& q,int target) {
    int originalSize=q.size(),removed=0;
    for(int i=0;i<originalSize;++i) {
        int value=q.dequeue();
        if(value==target) ++removed;
        else q.enqueue(value);
    }
    return removed;
}

int main() {
    LinkedQueue<int> q;for(int v:{2,1,2,3})q.enqueue(v);cout << removeValue(q,2) << endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <stdexcept>
using namespace std;

template<class T>
class LinkedQueue {
    struct Node {
        T info;
        Node* next;
        Node(const T& el) : info(el), next(nullptr) {}
    };
    Node *head, *tail;
    int count;
public:
    LinkedQueue() : head(nullptr), tail(nullptr), count(0) {}
    bool isEmpty() const { return head == nullptr; }
    int size() const { return count; }
    void enqueue(const T& el) {
        Node* node = new Node(el);
        if (tail == nullptr) head = node;
        else tail->next = node;
        tail = node;
        ++count;
    }
    T front() const {
        if (isEmpty()) throw runtime_error("Empty queue");
        return head->info;
    }
    T dequeue() {
        if (isEmpty()) throw runtime_error("Empty queue");
        T el = head->info;
        Node* tmp = head;
        head = head->next;
        if (head == nullptr) tail = nullptr;
        delete tmp;
        --count;
        return el;
    }
    ~LinkedQueue() { while (!isEmpty()) dequeue(); }
    LinkedQueue(const LinkedQueue&) = delete;
    LinkedQueue& operator=(const LinkedQueue&) = delete;
};

void mergeQueues(LinkedQueue<int>& a,LinkedQueue<int>& b,LinkedQueue<int>& result) {
    if(!result.isEmpty()) throw runtime_error("Result must start empty");
    while(!a.isEmpty() && !b.isEmpty()) {
        if(a.front()<=b.front()) result.enqueue(a.dequeue());
        else result.enqueue(b.dequeue());
    }
    while(!a.isEmpty()) result.enqueue(a.dequeue());
    while(!b.isEmpty()) result.enqueue(b.dequeue());
}

int main() {
    LinkedQueue<int> a,b,result;for(int v:{1,4,7})a.enqueue(v);for(int v:{2,4,8})b.enqueue(v);mergeQueues(a,b,result);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <exception>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

class StackException : public exception {
    string message;
public:
    explicit StackException(const string& msg) noexcept : message(msg) {}
    const char* what() const noexcept override { return message.c_str(); }
};

template <class T> class Stack {
private:
    typedef struct stackNode {
        struct stackNode *next;
        T theItem;
    } StackNode;
    StackNode *topOfStack;
    int count;
public:
    Stack() : topOfStack(NULL), count(0) {}
    void push(T item) {
        StackNode *newNode = new StackNode;
        newNode->theItem = item;
        newNode->next = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = newNode;
        ++count;
    }
    T pop(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Pop from empty stack");
        T item = topOfStack->theItem;
        StackNode *old = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = old->next;
        delete old;
        --count;
        return item;
    }
    T top(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Top of empty stack");
        return topOfStack->theItem;
    }
    int size(void) { return count; }
    bool isEmpty(void) { return count == 0; }

    ~Stack() { while (!isEmpty()) pop(); }
    Stack(const Stack&) = delete;
    Stack& operator=(const Stack&) = delete;
};

template<class T> class TwoStackQueue {
    Stack<T> incoming,outgoing;
    void prepareFront() {
        if(outgoing.isEmpty())
            while(!incoming.isEmpty()) outgoing.push(incoming.pop());
    }
public:
    bool isEmpty() { return incoming.isEmpty() && outgoing.isEmpty(); }
    void enqueue(T value) { incoming.push(value); }
    T front() { prepareFront();return outgoing.top(); }
    T dequeue() { prepareFront();return outgoing.pop(); }
};

int main() {
    TwoStackQueue<int> q;q.enqueue(1);q.enqueue(2);cout << q.dequeue() << endl;q.enqueue(3);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <stdexcept>
using namespace std;

struct Summary { int count; double total,average; };
Summary summarize(const double values[],int size) {
    if(size<0) throw invalid_argument("Negative size");
    Summary result{size,0,0};
    for(int i=0;i<size;++i) result.total+=values[i];
    if(size>0) result.average=result.total/size;
    return result;
}
double* scaledCopy(const double values[],int size,double scale=1) {
    if(size<0) throw invalid_argument("Negative size");
    double* result=new double[size];
    for(int i=0;i<size;++i) result[i]=values[i]*scale;
    return result;
}

int main() {
    double values[]={2,4,6};Summary s=summarize(values,3);double* copy=scaledCopy(values,3,2);cout<<s.average<<" "<<copy[2]<<endl;delete[] copy;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class Rectangle {
private:
    double length;
    double width;
public:
    Rectangle() : length(1), width(1) {}
    Rectangle(double l, double w) : length(l), width(w) {}
    double getLength() const { return length; }
    double getWidth() const { return width; }
    void setLength(double length) { this->length = length; }
    void setWidth(double width) { this->width = width; }
    double getArea() const { return length * width; }
};

int main() {
    Rectangle r(3, 4);
    r.setLength(5);
    double area = r.getArea();
    return 0;
}

Remember: This example counts calls to this constructor, not currently live objects; implicit copies are not counted. Do not put the outside definition in multiple .cpp files.

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class Shape {
public:
    virtual void draw() const = 0;
    virtual ~Shape() = default;
};

class RectangleShape : public Shape {
private:
    double length, width;
public:
    RectangleShape(double l, double w) : length(l), width(w) {}
    void draw() const override {
        cout << length << " x " << width << '\n';
    }
};

int main() {
    RectangleShape r(3, 4);
    Shape* shape = &r;
    shape->draw();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

double totalFile(const string& filename) {
    ifstream input(filename);
    if (!input) throw runtime_error("Cannot open file");
    double value, total = 0;
    while (input >> value) {
        total += value;
    }
    if (input.bad() || !input.eof()) {
        throw runtime_error("Invalid data or read error");
    }
    return total;
}

int main() {
    {
        ofstream output("scores.txt");
        output << "10 20 30\n";
    }
    double total = totalFile("scores.txt");
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

void appendValue(const string& filename, double value) {
    ofstream output(filename, ios::app);
    if (!output) throw runtime_error("Cannot open file");
    output << value << '\n';
    output.close();
    if (!output) throw runtime_error("Cannot write file");
}

int main() {
    appendValue("results.txt", 12.5);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <stdexcept>
using namespace std;

double quotient(double numerator, double denominator) {
    if (denominator == 0) {
        throw runtime_error("Cannot divide by zero");
    }
    return numerator / denominator;
}

int main() {
    try {
        double result = quotient(8, 2);
        (void)result;
    } catch (const exception& error) {
        cerr << error.what() << '\n';
    }
    return 0;
}

What to change for your question

Change the invalid condition and message; replace quotient with your own operation.

Explain the parts / things to remember
throw
Stop the current operation and transfer control to a matching handler.
try
Wrap calls that may throw.
catch by const reference
Read the exception without slicing it.
what()
Retrieve the error message.

Remember: Statements after a throw in the try block are skipped. An ordinary file-stream failure usually sets flags rather than throwing.

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class IntSLLNode {
public:
    IntSLLNode(int el, IntSLLNode *ptr = nullptr) { info = el; next = ptr; }
    int info;
    IntSLLNode *next;
};
class IntSLList {
    IntSLLNode *head, *tail;
public:
    IntSLList() { head = tail = nullptr; }
    int isEmpty() { return head == nullptr; }
    void addToHead(int el) {
        head = new IntSLLNode(el, head);
        if (tail == nullptr) tail = head;
    }
    void addToTail(int el) {
        if (tail != nullptr) {
            tail->next = new IntSLLNode(el);
            tail = tail->next;
        } else head = tail = new IntSLLNode(el);
    }
    int deleteFromHead() {
        int el = head->info;
        IntSLLNode *tmp = head;
        if (head == tail) head = tail = nullptr;
        else head = head->next;
        delete tmp;
        return el;
    }
    ~IntSLList() { while (!isEmpty()) deleteFromHead(); }

    IntSLList(const IntSLList&) = delete;
    IntSLList& operator=(const IntSLList&) = delete;
};

int main() {
    IntSLList lst;
    lst.addToHead(20);
    lst.addToTail(30);
    int first = lst.deleteFromHead();
    return 0;
}

IntSLLNode
info stores the integer; next links to the following node.
head / tail

addToHead / addToTail
Update links, then update the relevant end pointer.
deleteFromHead
Save the value and node, update links, delete the old node, return the value.

Remember: deleteFromHead requires a nonempty list. Destructor frees nodes; copying is disabled to avoid shared raw ownership.

#include <iostream>
#include <exception>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

class StackException : public exception {
    string message;
public:
    explicit StackException(const string& msg) noexcept : message(msg) {}
    const char* what() const noexcept override { return message.c_str(); }
};

template <class T> class Stack {
private:
    typedef struct stackNode {
        struct stackNode *next;
        T theItem;
    } StackNode;
    StackNode *topOfStack;
    int count;
public:
    Stack() : topOfStack(NULL), count(0) {}
    void push(T item) {
        StackNode *newNode = new StackNode;
        newNode->theItem = item;
        newNode->next = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = newNode;
        ++count;
    }
    T pop(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Pop from empty stack");
        T item = topOfStack->theItem;
        StackNode *old = topOfStack;
        topOfStack = old->next;
        delete old;
        --count;
        return item;
    }
    T top(void) {
        if (isEmpty()) throw StackException("Top of empty stack");
        return topOfStack->theItem;
    }
    int size(void) { return count; }
    bool isEmpty(void) { return count == 0; }

    ~Stack() { while (!isEmpty()) pop(); }
    Stack(const Stack&) = delete;
    Stack& operator=(const Stack&) = delete;
};

int main() {
    Stack<int> s;
    s.push(10);
    s.push(20);
    int peek = s.top();
    int removed = s.pop();
    return 0;
}

Explain the parts / things to remember
StackNode / theItem / next
A node holds one item and the link below it.
topOfStack / count
The top node and the current item count.
push
Create a node, link to old top, move top, increment count.
pop
Save the item, advance top, delete the old node, decrement count, return item.
top / isEmpty / size
Inspect without removing; empty access throws StackException.

Remember: This uses the lab API: pop returns T. Keep template code in the header. Cleanup and disabled copying are practice additions.

#include <iostream>
#include <list>
using namespace std;

template<class T>
class ListQueue {
public:
	ListQueue() {
	}
	void clear() {
		lst.clear();
	}
	bool isEmpty() const {
		return lst.empty();
	}
	T& front() {
		return lst.front();
	}
	T dequeue() {
		T el = lst.front();
		lst.pop_front();
		return el;
	}
	void enqueue(const T& el) {
		lst.push_back(el);
	}
private:
	list<T> lst;
};

int main() {
    ListQueue<int> q;
    q.enqueue(10);
    q.enqueue(20);
    int first = q.dequeue();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

template<class T, int size = 100>
class ArrayQueue {
public:
	ArrayQueue() {
		first = last = -1;
	}
	void enqueue(T);
	T dequeue();
	bool isFull() {
		return (first == 0 && last == size-1) || (first == last + 1);
	}
	bool isEmpty() {
		return first == -1;
	}

private:
	int first, last;
	T storage[size];
};

template<class T, int size>
void ArrayQueue<T,size>::enqueue(T el) {
	if (!isFull())
		if (last == size-1 || last == -1) {
			storage[0] = el;
			last = 0;
			if (first == -1)
				first = 0;
		}
		else storage[++last] = el;
	else cout << "Full queue.\n";
}

template<class T, int size>
T ArrayQueue<T,size>::dequeue() {
	T tmp;
	tmp = storage[first];
	if (first == last)
		last = first = -1;
	else if (first == size-1)
		first = 0;
	else first++;
	return tmp;
}

int main() {
    ArrayQueue<int, 4> q;
    q.enqueue(10);
    q.enqueue(20);
    int first = q.dequeue();
    return 0;
}

Explain the parts / things to remember
storage[size]
Fixed array of queue elements.
first / last
Oldest and newest occupied indexes; -1 marks empty.
enqueue
Check full, wrap last if needed, store the value.
dequeue
Save the front value; reset if it was the last item, otherwise advance/wrap first.

Remember: Call dequeue only when nonempty. A full enqueue prints “Full queue.” and does not insert; it does not throw.
